newsitem.title: UK: BCC says strong sterling hitting large UK firms.
newsitem.headline: BCC says strong sterling hitting large UK firms.

text.p: The British Chambers of Commerce (BCC) said the strength of sterling against major currencies was now becoming a serious issue for manufacturers.

"Concern over the exchange rate has risen 18 percent over the last quarter, the biggest leap since the question was first asked in the third quarter of 1989," said BCC deputy director general Ian Peters, presenting its economic survey for the fourth quarter of 1996.
"Large firms are being hit worst, with 95 percent saying it is hindering their business."
